items.problem: Data-bound NavigationView master/detail navigation dead for scenarios 2-9 (8/9 features fail): ItemInvoked handler resolves the invoked item via InvokedItemContainer.DataContext, which is unreliable under a MenuItemTemplate.
items.evidence: migration-score.json (8 fail, dead-scenario); discrepancies.json; session-log NavView_ItemInvoked copied verbatim from MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #navigationview-frame-wiring.
items.root_cause: The skill's own navigationview-frame-wiring MenuItemsSource snippet reads args.InvokedItemContainer?.DataContext instead of args.InvokedItem. Under a MenuItemTemplate the container DataContext is not reliably the bound data object, so the cast fails and Navigate never runs. Docs: NavigationViewItemInvokedEventArgs.InvokedItem IS the invoked data item.
items.change: Rewrote the MenuItemsSource ItemInvoked snippet to `if (args.InvokedItem is Scenario s) ScenarioFrame.Navigate(s.ClassType);`, removed the confusing empty first if-block, added an explicit 'do NOT read InvokedItemContainer.DataContext' warning, and updated the closing 'do not mix' note. Sharpened the SKILL.md shell-mapping hint to name args.InvokedItem.
items.expected_effect: Migrations that copy this snippet get a working data-bound NavigationView: every scenario navigates on invoke, not just the first.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run of a master/detail SDK-sample migration, selecting scenarios 2..N switches ScenarioFrame content (parity requirements 2-9 go fail->pass), not just the Loaded-navigated first page.

deferred_to_human: Tier-0/eval: the smoke launch (Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 Section 7 / eval skills) passes on an alive-only, first-page-renders check and cannot see dead scenarios. Not fixable in the migration skill; a future harness could assert Frame content changes across nav items.
